projection: Dominant face axis in world space
uv_code: float3 N = abs(Normal); if (N.z >= max(N.x, N.y)) return float2(World.x, -World.y) / Period + 0.5; if (N.x >= N.y) return float2(World.y, -World.z) / Period + 0.5; return float2(World.x, -World.z) / Period + 0.5;
tradeoff: Pattern size is independent of instance scaling; world-projected color no longer follows the source-luminance relief one-to-one.
